identity.title: Exploratory Gate C Policy Permit Core
identity.objective: Implement the V2.1 credential-free exploratory Gate-C policy-permit core: read the existing STRAT-LIFE and Hermes strategy-manager stores through their verified read-only loaders, bind the current exact StrategyVersion/active global PortfolioAuthorityPolicy/current EXPLORATORY_LIVE allocation/latest compatible Hermes assessment and an exact fresh FEASIBLE or LIMITED EXEC-FEAS intent/snapshot/assessment into a canonical hard eligibility decision and, only on success, a short-lived exact-intent exploratory permit. The permit creates execution-eligibility authority only; it performs no network/account/geoblock read, loads no credential, issues no legacy GateCLivePermit, enters no A3 state, signs/submits/cancels no order, creates no new store/scheduler/live authority and risks USD 0.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the exact S10-GATE-C-EXPLORE-01 diff. The credential-free exploratory Gate-C decision/permit package, focused tests, contract/status/spec/certificate and V2.1/live-authorization doc reconciliation disappear. STRAT-LIFE, HERMES-STRAT, EXEC-FEAS and legacy WP175 execution-gateway bytes remain unchanged; there is no new database, credential, order, account, live, deployment or capital state to migrate or roll back.

items.required_rule: Public evaluator accepts explicit lifecycle_store_path and hermes_manager_store_path, loads both through existing verified read-only loaders at evaluation time, persists neither path, and never accepts a caller-fabricated lifecycle/Hermes snapshot as authority.

Target StrategyVersion must exist in verified lifecycle state; exactly the current active EXPLORATORY_LIVE allocation with positive budget must be active at evaluated_at_ns under the active policy; evaluate_portfolio_capacity must be globally valid and target strategy valid; Gate C never mutates policy, allocation, health or restrictions.
items.safe_output: PERMIT_REJECTED plus closed Gate-C and inherited capacity reasons

items.required_rule: Gate C selects the latest same-StrategyVersion HermesStrategyAssessment from the verified manager store itself; supplied historical assessments are not accepted; assessment active_policy_id and strategy_lifecycle_context_sha256 must match current target-strategy state. New exposure permits only CONTINUE or SCALE with risk direction UNCHANGED/INCREASE, recommended health not QUARANTINED/RETIRED, and target_risk_band null or not PAPER.

Exact ExecutionIntent validates against the current StrategyVersion; exact PublicExecutionVenueSnapshot validates; supplied ExecutionFeasibilityAssessment must round-trip and equal assess_execution_feasibility(intent,snapshot,assessment.evaluated_at_ns). Only FEASIBLE or LIMITED can be permit-eligible; INCONCLUSIVE/NOT_FEASIBLE reject.

intent execution_style must be in active policy allowed_order_styles; exact Decimal intent notional requested_shares*price_limit must equal assessment.intent_notional_at_price_limit_usd and be <= allocation active_budget_usd, policy max_order_notional_usd, and policy max_per_market_usd. This is static exact-intent bounding only and makes no account-capacity claim.
items.safe_output: ORDER_STYLE_NOT_ALLOWED or closed order-notional rejection reasons

items.required_rule: evaluated_at_ns is explicit caller-supplied deterministic evidence time and must be >= feasibility evaluated_at_ns; public_mechanics_deadline_ns = book_timestamp_ns + intent.max_public_data_age_ns. GTD additionally uses effective deadline expiration_unix_s*1e9-60s. permit_valid_until_ns is min(public deadline, policy expiry if any, allocation expiry if any, GTD effective deadline if any); eligibility requires evaluated_at_ns < valid_until.

ExploratoryGateCDecision is immutable, closed-schema, bounded and content-addressed over every field except decision_id; it records eligibility/rejection, compact Gate-C reasons, inherited capacity reasons, exact upstream identities and deadlines; no raw store path, secret, account data or upstream exception text.

ExploratoryGateCPermit can be built only from an exact PERMIT_ELIGIBLE decision and exact validated inputs; it authorizes only the exact intent parameters and exact authorized_order_notional_usd, is immutable/content-addressed over every field except permit_id, and cannot be widened by caller values.

Decision and permit invariants require later runtime revalidation of account, access/geoblock, reconciliation and runtime identity. No balance/allowance/positions/open-orders/loss/drawdown/geoblock/credential/host truth is claimed here.
No src/execution_gateway edit/import; no GateCLivePermit, GateCSession, _GATE_C_ISSUER, _GATE_C_EVENT_ISSUER or A3 transition; WP175 remains the separate historical manual real-canary path.

Zero network, credentials, authenticated clients, signing, order submission/cancel, execution transport, paper, scheduler, daemon, new persistence or live authority; reads only existing canonical local stores through verified loaders and evaluates caller-supplied canonical EXEC-FEAS objects.
